distinctions.agents: Six fresh Gemini3.1 Flash-Lite calls across two review rounds.
distinctions.models: A real local forest was trained and validated; per-shopper scoring uses that model, not an LLM call.
distinctions.payments: The frozen simulator executes authorization, capture, supplier settlement and refunds. Native PayPal calls were disabled in this comparison; the existing Sandbox integration remains separately accessible.
distinctions.scope: One fresh campaign with identical paired inputs. It demonstrates autonomous operation, not superior performance or production PayPal ROI.

improvementNeeded: The manager reduced contact capacity and stock coverage without a measured economic preview. Add coverage/settlement impact tools and compare a proposed campaign before publication; better prediction alone does not imply higher profit.
